```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(csapAIH)
library(territorio)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
csaprs <- fetchcsap(2017, 2023, uf = "RS") %>% 
  inner_join(territorio("RS"), by = c(munres = "CO_MUNICIP"))
summary(csaprs)

csaprsxmun <- csaprs %>% 
  mutate(ano  = lubridate::year(data.inter)) %>% 
  group_by(ano, munres, nomemun, sexo, fxetar5, csap, grupo, CO_MACSAUD, nomemacsaude, CO_MICIBGE, nomemicibge, CO_REGMETR, nomeregmetr, CO_REGSAUD, nomeregsaude) %>% 
  count(name = "casos") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(csaprs %>% 
               select(munres, NU_LATITUD, NU_LONGIT), multiple = "any") %>% 
  relocate(casos, .after = grupo)

```
